archetypes.name: dyn-cas-mutations
archetypes.rationale: The new issue and dependency mutation sequences rely on exact freshness advancement and read-back ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed triage apply and block-issue paths for compare-and-swap gaps between GitHub calls. Verify every mutation is preceded by a live target recheck, every success is followed by exact surface or relationship read-back, and no later mutation runs after stale or malformed state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
